method.notes: Sources identical, production builds, one server at a time, cyclic engine order, new server each run. Before uses saved pre-change native binary AND preserved built runtime. Next preserved audit build. CPU and RSS sum server descendants, load client excluded but shares host. RSS shared pages may be counted twice; client can limit fast routes. Three short trials per route/capacity; sustained one trial. Bounded overload remains intentional beyond 272 in-flight requests per worker.
method.nativeProxy: 16 active upstream streams and 256 waiters; bodies unread while waiting

corrections.reason: Host ephemeral TCP port exhaustion after legacy stress. macOS net.inet.tcp.msl=15000. Seven affected trials (one partial load, six startup/warmup failures) excluded from final performance comparisons and rerun after recovery; initial observations retained here.
